site.name: Mridanga Seva
site.description: A volunteer-run class in Hyderabad that teaches the mṛdaṅga (khol), the two-headed drum of kīrtana, as seva.

ui.draftNote: Draft for team review. Text marked “To confirm” is not settled yet.
ui.noCookies: This website sets no cookies and does not track you.

home.title: Learn the mṛdaṅga as seva
home.description: Mridanga Seva teaches the mṛdaṅga (khol), the two-headed drum of kīrtana, in Abids, Hyderabad. Learn how the class works and how to join.

classes.title: Classes
classes.description: How the Mridanga Seva class runs: an open window you come to when it suits you, three levels, coordinators who teach and a facilitator who assesses.

join.title: How to join
join.description: Joining the Mridanga Seva class in a few steps: come to the class, register at the desk, sign in to the app and start at the Beginner level.

app.title: Get the app
app.description: The Mridanga Seva app for students and coordinators: Android app now, web version for iPhone and computers coming soon.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.description: How Mridanga Seva handles personal data in its class and app, under India's DPDP Act 2023 and the EU GDPR. This website sets no cookies.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Write to Mridanga Seva: info@mridangaseva.com for questions about the class, privacy@mridangaseva.com for questions about your data.

art.anatomyAlt: Diagram of the mṛdaṅga: the large bass head (bāyāṅ) and the small head (dāyāṅ) face on, each with a braided rim (gajarā), an outer ring (kinār), a middle field (maidān) and a black centre (syāhī); below, the clay body (aṅga) from the side.
